assertions.description: document.startViewTransition(options) reads the shadowRoots member of the options dictionary (a getter on it runs before 'types' and 'update', per WebIDL lexicographic member order).
assertions.test: (()=>{const S1={},S2={};try{document.startViewTransition({get shadowRoots(){throw S1},get types(){throw S2},get update(){throw S2}});return false}catch(e){return e===S1}})()

assertions.description: Element.prototype.startViewTransition(options) reads the same shadowRoots member (the dictionary is shared by document- and element-scoped transitions).
assertions.test: (()=>{const S1={},S2={};try{document.createElement('div').startViewTransition({get shadowRoots(){throw S1},get types(){throw S2},get update(){throw S2}});return false}catch(e){return e===S1}})()

assertions.description: shadowRoots is converted as sequence<ShadowRoot>: any iterable of ShadowRoot objects is consumed via its iterator before 'types' is read.
assertions.test: (()=>{const h=document.createElement('div');const sr=h.attachShadow({mode:'open'});let it=false;const S2={};try{document.startViewTransition({shadowRoots:{[Symbol.iterator]:function*(){it=true;yield sr}},get types(){throw S2},get update(){throw S2}});return false}catch(e){return e===S2&&it}})()

assertions.description: An entry that is not a ShadowRoot (here document.body) throws TypeError while converting the options, before any transition is created.
assertions.test: (()=>{const S2={};try{document.startViewTransition({shadowRoots:[document.body],get types(){throw S2},get update(){throw S2}});return false}catch(e){return e instanceof TypeError}})()

assertions.description: The sequence element type is non-nullable: shadowRoots: [null] (e.g. a closed host's .shadowRoot read from outside) throws TypeError.
assertions.test: (()=>{const S2={};try{document.startViewTransition({shadowRoots:[null],get types(){throw S2},get update(){throw S2}});return false}catch(e){return e instanceof TypeError}})()

assertions.description: A view-transition-name declared in a listed shadow root's own stylesheet is captured by an element-scoped transition (a ::view-transition-group(<name>) animation exists on the scope element).
Without listing it, the same shadow-scoped name is NOT captured: participation is opt-in, never automatic discovery.
Names from a listed root share one namespace with the scope's tree: the same name in the light tree and in the listed shadow root makes transition.ready reject with InvalidStateError.
